note: The Credit Bureau Regulations (Government Notice 103 of 2014, surviving under the Bank of Namibia Act 1 of 2020), regulation 31: a data subject's payment profile is retained five years from the event; read in the Legal Assistance Centre's annotated statutes, registered as secondary. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Credit Bureau Regulations, Government Notice 103 of 2014 (Legal Assistance Centre, annotated statutes)
sources.said: “payment profile” means the payment history of the consumer in respect of a particular transaction. ... Any favourable and unfavourable credit performance information of a data subject is retained in the credit bureau database ... Payment profile the payment profile of the data 5 years
